title: Trace a Kafka delivery failure
description: Inject one ambiguous failure, then choose producer and consumer contracts. Follow what is stored, replayed, committed, and applied outside Kafka.

producerContracts.label: Leader acknowledgement
producerContracts.detail: acks=1, retries enabled, producer idempotence disabled

producerContracts.label: Durable idempotent producer
producerContracts.detail: acks=all, retries enabled, idempotence enabled, min ISR=2

consumerContracts.label: Commit before side effect
consumerContracts.detail: Progress advances first; a crash can skip unfinished business work.

consumerContracts.label: Commit after side effect
consumerContracts.detail: A crash can replay the record; the destination must recognize the same operation.

consumerContracts.label: Kafka read-process-write transaction
consumerContracts.detail: Atomically publish Kafka output and source offsets; external systems remain outside.

scenarios.label: Producer response is lost
scenarios.detail: The leader appended the batch, but the acknowledgement never reached the producer. The client retries.
scenarios.failureStage: After broker append, before producer receives acknowledgement

scenarios.label: Leader fails before replication
scenarios.detail: Only the leader has the record when that broker becomes unavailable.
scenarios.failureStage: After local append, before a follower copies the record

scenarios.label: Consumer crashes at the side-effect boundary
scenarios.detail: The crash falls between consumer progress and the external database mutation; the selected commit order decides whether work is skipped or replayed.
scenarios.failureStage: Between offset progress and the external side effect
